## 🪔 Diwali Feature / Contribution Pull Request

### 📝 Description of Changes
*Please describe the feature, enhancement, or bug fix you implemented. What was your creative idea?*

### 🎨 Type of Contribution
- [ ] 🎆 New Firework / Cracker Effect
- [ ] 🪔 New Festival Minigame or Mission
- [ ] 🏛️ 3D World / Architecture / Decorator Enhancement
- [ ] 👗 Avatar Customization / Skin / Outfit
- [ ] 🎵 Audio / Sound Synthesis Enhancement
- [ ] 📱 Mobile Controls & Responsive UX
- [ ] 🐛 Bug Fix
- [ ] 📚 Documentation / Accessibility

### 📸 Screenshots or Video (if applicable)
*Attach screenshots or short video demonstrating your new feature in action.*

### ✅ Contributor Checklist
- [ ] I have tested this feature locally using `npm start` at `http://localhost:3000`.
- [ ] I ran automated tests with `npm test` and all tests passed with 0 errors.
- [ ] I followed existing coding styles and conventions.
- [ ] I added my name and GitHub profile link to `public/contributors.json` so I appear in the game's Hall of Fame!
